deployments_detail.use: AI-powered visual inspection of post-welding surfaces at Nidec's next-generation smart factory; the AI performs product quality judgment (previously done by human visual inspection) fully automatically, preventing complex products from being left uninspected and stopping defective units from escaping. [Nidec (in-house/proprietary; no external vendor named)]

AI automation of sensory inspection (sight, hearing, touch), previously performed manually, plus AI-assisted collaborative robots for assembly, at Nidec Mobility's Iida Factory (Nagano); being rolled out to eight overseas plants to raise efficiency and reduce required headcount. [Nidec Mobility (in-house)]

AURCA-series AI-based automated optical inspection & measurement solution (product) for semiconductors and printed substrates; a proprietary AI algorithm detects defects/abnormalities conventional imaging misses, with full-color scanning and real-time inspection-analysis-feedback loops for yield improvement. [Nidec Advance Technology (proprietary AI algorithm)]

LAMDA-series (LAMDA200/500/2000/5000) laser powder DED metal additive-manufacturing machines with integrated AI/machine-learning-based anomaly detection for real-time melt-pool monitoring and closed-loop process control, protecting against defects and process drift. [Nidec Machine Tool America (in-house AI)]

ADAS camera-and-radar sensor-fusion driver-assistance products (Nidec Elesys) using image-recognition software and detection-algorithm software to detect vehicles, pedestrians and road markings; company R&D targets advanced recognition algorithms toward autonomous driving. (AI/deep-learning not explicitly stated in source, so treated as claimed.) [Nidec Elesys]

Nidec Advance Technology partnership with Gantu Technology to develop and deliver AI inspection and test solutions for electronic circuit boards and semiconductor advanced packaging, combining Nidec's high-accuracy measurement/mechatronics with AI defect analysis. [Nidec Advance Technology + Gantu Technology]

AI-based route optimization for automated guided vehicles (AGVs) on the smart-factory floor; AGVs use QR-code identification and AI to optimize travel paths and adapt to flexible route/layout changes for material movement. [Nidec (in-house)]

Nidec Automobile Motor (Zhejiang) uses AI and machine-learning algorithms to analyze massive production-process data for equipment failure prediction (predictive maintenance), production data processing and quality optimization; recognized as Zhejiang Province's first-class smart factory. [Nidec (AI/ML with SAP, MES, WMS integration)]
no confirmed internal AI deployment found (supplies cooling/components FOR AI data centers; benefits from AI market but not disclosed as AI user)
